implementation: outer product lifecycle gate around AW17 while preserving AW17 as the only Playback-token authority
ordinary product commands blocked before AW17 and before Playback generation while interruption lifecycle is non-idle
pause during interruption consumes no token and suppresses automatic resume
automatic resume requires both resolved pre-interruption playing intent and OS shouldResume=true
monotonic playing-intent order serial waits for older already-started play-state mutations before resume eligibility is captured
lifecycle revision makes older interruption-end/resume completion stale after a newer interruption event
pause while automatic-resume play is already in flight triggers compensating AW17 pause after that play completes
AW17 recoveryBlocked is recovered before accepting interruption boundaries when possible
failed interruption-end generation authority enters endedRecoveryRequired and blocks normal commands until explicit retry

portable_benchmark.scope: exact AW18 lifecycle/order source atop interface-compatible lightweight AW17/Playback/coordinator types; excludes AVAudioEngine, AudioUnit, actual AVAudioSession delivery, real Playback/DSP backend cost, device/file IO, real audio and current-Moises execution

hq_integration_requirements: instantiate one project-scoped Lane3InterruptionLifecycleGate around the selected project-scoped AW17 authority
route all product token-producing Playback/DSP controls through the interruption gate once selected; do not bypass with direct AW17 or RescheduleFencedPlaybackBackend token calls
map iOS AVAudioSession interruption began to submitInterruptionBegan
pass the actual AVAudioSession interruption-ended shouldResume bit to submitInterruptionEnded(shouldResume:)
allow user pause during interruption through the gate to suppress auto-resume without creating a token
when phase is endedRecoveryRequired use retryEndedInterruptionRecovery before ordinary commands
validate real phone/Siri/route interruption timing and audible restart behavior on physical iPhone
